2014_spells.polar-ray.description: A blue-white ray of freezing ice streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 9d8 cold damage, and its speed is halved until the start of your next turn.
2014_spells.polar-ray.effectSummary: Deal 9d8 cold damage to a target within 120 ft
